Unified Transport Authority
*101. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
URBAN DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that his Ministry
proposes to set up a Unified Metropolitan
Transport Authority for coordinated
planning between the States and the Centre
for controlling the vehicular movement in
urban areas;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the proposed authority is a
part of the National Policy on Urban
Transport;
(d) whether any consultation has been
held in this regard with the Chief Ministers
and Transport Ministers of the States; and
(e) if so, the outcome thereof?
National Text Book Council
*102. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
SHRI R.S. GAVAI:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Central
Advisory Board of Education (CABE)
Committee has recommended for setting
up of a National Text Book Council;
(b) if so, the details of its
recommendations; and
(c) the action Government propose to
take in this regard?
Menace of beggars
†*103. DR. A.K. PATEL: Will the
Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
the number of beggars and other vendors is
on the constant rise at the traffic signals on
Delhi roads;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
accidents on roads are rising as a result
thereof; and
(c) if so, the measures Government
propose to take to check the same?

Projects in Bodoland Territorial Areas
of Assam
*104. SHRI URKHAO GWRA
BRAHMA: Will the Minister of
DEVELOPMENT OF NORTH
EASTERN REGION be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the funds released for
the various projects in the Bodoland
Territorial Areas District (BTAD) of Assam
out of the amount of Rs. 500 crores as
committed in the Bodo Accord, 2005;
(b) the details of ongoing projects within
BTAD area; and
(c) the details of progress of the work?
Proclamation of Sunni Wakf Board of
U.P.
*105. SHRIMATI BIMBA RAIKAR:
SHRI DATTA MEGHE:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are keeping a
close watch on the proclamation of the
Sunni Wakf Board of U.P. certifying the
historic monument Taj Mahal as a Wakf
property;
(b) whether Government propose to
challenge the claim in a higher court of law;
and
(c) whether anticipating a spate of such
claims to historic monuments elsewhere in
the country as Wakf property, Centre
would pre-empt such claims through an
Ordinance?
School dropouts
†*106. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the number
of students reduces upto 10 per cent by
the time they reach 12th standard from 1st
standard;
(b) if not, the facts in this regard;
(c) whether it is also a fact that due to
lack of required facilities for secondary and
higher secondary education in the country,
there is rampant corruption in education
sector; and
(d) if so, Government's reaction thereto?
Compulsory Education Bill
*107. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Advisory Board
of Education (CABE) has considered/is
considering a Compulsory Education Bill;
(b) if so, whether there is any proposal
to introduce common school system as per
the National Education Policy, 1986, in the
Compulsory Education Bill;
(c) if so, the details thereof including
the decision taken, if any;
(d) whether there is any proposal before
CABE that would result in abdication of
State's constitutional obligation to provide
adequate financial resources for elementary
education;
(e) if so, the action taken thereon;
(f) whether there is any delay in
finalizing Compulsory Education Bill; and
(g) if so, the reasons therefor?
Affairs of institutions for disabled
*108. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that three apex

33
institutions for the disabled are practically
headless;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is also a fact that
Government had abolished the National
Disability Commission; and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor?

Renovation of Mahabodhi temple
complex
644. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that Mahabodhi temple complex,
holiest shrine of Buddhism, is in a state of
disrepair, amidst garbage and sewage and
facilities are non existent;
(b) whether it is a fact that the toilets in
the complex are in a sorry state and none is
W.C. or disabled friendly; and
(c) if so, the steps Government propose
to take to renovate the temple complex?
 Preservation of historical documents
645. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is fact that historic
documents lying in official custodian of the
National Archives are not properly
preserved;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps Government are taking for
preservation of these documents?
 Jama Masjid
†646. SHRI SURENDRA LATH:
SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Jama
Masjid constructed by the Mughal
Emperor is a historical and cultural heritage
of Delhi and it is necessary to conserve it
but in spite of its being under control of the
Wakf Board it has become the property of
a particular person;
(b) if so, whether he is also aware of the
fact that there is insanitation, crowd and
illegal construction around it which is
changing the shape of its cultural heritage;
(c) if so, by when it would be declared
as protected building; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

148
 Ram Niwas Mirdha Committee
recommendations
647. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
SHRI EKANATH K.
THAKUR:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Ram Niwas Mirdha
Committee had submitted its findings in
1984;
(b) if so, whether this expert committee
had recommended that ASI should have
atleast 9000 monument attendants to cover
all the monuments and wanted it to have a
security force of its own;
(c) if so, the reasons for not taking so
far any action on the above
recommendations;
(d) whether Government are now
considering to implement its
recommendations;
(e) if not, the reasons therefor;
(f) if so, how many of its
recommendations have been fully
considered; and
(g) by when these are likely to be
implemented?
 Reports of excavations by ASI
648. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the ASI has
come in for a severe criticism from the
Parliamentary Standing Committee for its
lethargy in not writing reports of the
excavations it has undertaken, thus wasting
public funds;
(b) whether it is a fact that the previous
panel, too, had pointed out this lapse and
in spite of it, his Ministry has done nothing
to document the excavations;
(c) whether it is a fact that the post of
the Director of National Archives has been
filled up temporarily; and
(d) if so, the steps Government propose
to take to write timely reports of the
excavations?
 Khajuraho temples
649. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that conservation has taken a back
seat at 1000 year old Chandela temples at
Khajuraho;
(b) whether it is a fact that there is
substantial seepage in main temples, plants
are sprouting amid sculptures and the city
of Khajuraho provides not even a public
toilet for the tourist; and
(c) if so, the steps Government propose
to take to restore this historic monument?
 Discovery of ancient civilization
650. SHRIMATI SUKHBUNS KAUR:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether excavators have lately
stumbled upon the remains of a busting
ancient civilization and urban settlement in
Kotalal, Anantnag district of South
Kashmir;
(b) if so, what important and significant
findings suggesting existence of such ancient
urban settlement were made;
(c) whether any such findings
suggesting ancient settlements and

149
civilizations have also been made in
Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Uttar
Pradesh and other States during the last
five years; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
 Original  writings of Mahatma
651. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is fact that the original
writings of Mahatma Gandhi have been
tempered with;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government has taken any
action against the persons responsible for
this act; and
